description: Catalog provenance for data supplied by Spring Brand. Sources are labeled A through F.

governance.acquisition_method: Spring Brand compiled catalog data held on its internal platform and supplied it to the research team.
governance.provider_authorization: Spring Brand authorized research use of the supplied catalog and publication of the adapted benchmark data.
governance.redistribution_permission: Spring Brand permits publication of the adapted benchmark data, subject to restrictions on further redistribution.

canonicalization.sellable_row_rule: non-empty SKU and strictly positive parseable sale price
canonicalization.duplicate_source_sku_rule: first sellable occurrence per merchant and source SKU in source order
canonicalization.cross_merchant_product_linkage: not inferred without a verified crosswalk
canonicalization.inventory_rule: out-of-stock=0; in-stock count deterministically sampled from seed, merchant, and source SKU
